documents.notes: 'Apply' page (dates, deadlines and checklist; transcripts; recommendations; essays). Test scores are optional: 'Duke University is test-optional for both first-year and transfer applicants in the 2026-2027 admissions cycle' (an application cycle, so academic_year is left null). Duke does not accept separate resumes. One optional personal recommendation and optional interviews are not drafted. Final official transcript required of admitted students.

items.quote: First-year applicants may apply using the Common Application or QuestBridge Application for eligible students.
Official transcripts for all academic work completed in high school are required and must be submitted by your school counselor or another school official.
We require three letters of recommendation for each applicant: one from your school counselor
We require three letters of recommendation for each applicant: one from your school counselor and two from teachers who have taught you in major academic courses
The Common Application includes a one-page personal essay and short essay questions specific to Duke.
If you are a non-native English speaker or if you are not currently studying in an English-medium curriculum, we recommend but do not require that you take an English proficiency test.
Duke University is test-optional for both first-year and transfer applicants
For international students whose transcripts need to be translated into English, students may use an official service, an EducationUSA adviser, or a school official.
items.condition: transcripts need to be translated into English (originals submitted with the translations)
